page.overview:
What is Graceful Promising?

The Graceful Promising was a Vontorian treasure ship. At one point by 10 BBY, it became cracked apart and settled in an orbit around a dark star. The Pirate Queen Maz Kanata eventually stashed a cache of kiirium aboard the starship, which the smuggler Han Solo, assisted by Rebel Alliance Lieutenant Caluan Ematt and a few rebel Pathfinders, successfully retrieved at some point between 0 ABY and 3 ABY. The Graceful Promising and the retrieval of its treasure was documented in the logbook known as the Smuggler's Guide.

The Graceful Promising was a Vontorian treasure ship that became cracked apart at some point by 10 BBY. It settled in a close orbit around a dark star on the eastern edge of the galaxy. The Pirate Queen Maz Kanata eventually stashed a cache of relatively valuable kiirium outfitted with an antitamper sub-space alarm aboard the derelict starship. She marked its location on a map of the treasure caches she had hidden throughout the galaxy that was included in the Smuggler's Guide logbook.

At one point between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, the human smuggler Han Solo acquired the Smuggler's Guide. In order to try and earn funds needed to repay a debt to the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, Solo decided to try and access Kanata's treasure cache aboard the Graceful Promising, which he considered one of the pirate queen's more challenging caches but nevertheless worth the attempt—an opinion that the smuggler noted on Kanata's map too.

Solo recognized the difficulties lying ahead that were posed by the gravitational shear caused by the nearby dark star, however. For the mission to the Graceful Promising he also brought along the Alliance Lieutenant Caluan Ematt as well as a few rebel Pathfinders. The smuggler made an entry in the Smuggler's Guide noting his plans and included an image of the vessel—the name of which he misspelled as the Grateful Promising in one instance—with the entry.
